changelog:
Testing Build (vc20-0210) vs Testing Build (vc21-0910)

Changes

- Containers flagged Autostart now start automatically whenever the server boots (and after the restart that follows an update or rollback), one by one, with stale PID/pgid leftovers cleaned first so a recycled PID can never be mistaken for a live container; only autostart-enabled containers come back - others stay as they are.

- Updates are now container-aware: when the new version changes critical files (scripts/container.sh or server/ankd/ankd.sh) the panel stops the running containers one by one before applying and the Autostart ones return after the restart; versions without critical changes leave containers untouched. The panel also pre-downloads and SHA-verifies the zip itself before handing it to the updater, so the whole run is one continuous progress log (download, verify, stopping containers, backup, extract, resync, propagate, DONE).

- New Rollback button in Settings > Update: while an older version exists in the update backup, a single click restores the previous version (module code + runtime server), resyncs the live copies, propagates ankd.sh and brings the Autostart containers back - with the same critical-file rules as an update (containers restart only when the restored files differ from what is running).

- Updater states and log refactored for the new flow: panel phases (download, verify, stopping containers, spawned) and rollback phases (rollback, restore, resync, propagate, starting containers) all report to the same progress pane, and a stale RUNNING state is ignored 30 minutes after it was written so a crashed run can never lock the update page.
